title: Bound the chart-265 terminal contraction for public 720
body:
**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On exact #7481, test deleting public720's terminal rank-one MOVE45363, lowering its productive endpoint from rank four to rank three, and replacing ADD45364 before MOVE41307 in chart265. Keep earlier outward reads and the owned1511 history fixed.

Input x0=2, x7=−1 and x720=−1/4, with other coordinates zero, annihilates all six offered rows, including old720. The earlier role92 at MOVE32750 is zero, while the later version captured by ADD33129 is 1. Independent whole-word normalized forward replay confirms the old and edited final 720 values −1/4 and 0, and verifies the prior observations and owner ledger. One fixed case exhausted. Other source timings, cuts and changed banks remain open.

The hypothetical signed paid delta is −17 rank-one. Productive delta is +17 rank-three and −17 rank-four. Directed gross is [0.13900113391906015,0.13900113391906017] raw across 17 calls before corrections and ancillary costs. An extra rank-one job per copy costs 17 raw. No saving was realized.

## Exact inputs and replay

Canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57, #7481 at 89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b and signed #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. The two #7257 CI prerequisites are separate ancestor commits. From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12 and standard library:

    python3.12 -I -B research/p104-public720-terminal-contraction-bound/replay.py

Expected PASS_PUBLIC720_TERMINAL_CONTRACTION_BOUND. Both scientific processes passed within 30 seconds. Direct and registered replay, exact committed bytes and modes, source history, read-only Git-free export and all 27 local onboarding tests passed on tree 107d5d43134f5924ed73d7e20955d0ccd0508033. Hosted verification is separate.
